result:
I’d make it so that having power over someone reliably came with a sense of responsibility toward them.

Not perfect kindness. Just a strong resistance to treating another person as expendable because they can’t stop you.

That would reach into families, workplaces, governments, wars—even how we treat animals. It wouldn’t eliminate conflict or suffering. But it would change what happens at the moment someone realizes they can get away with cruelty.
